title: Keep joined RPL state unchanged on malformed authenticated DIO
description: Full lichen-node gate exposes stale multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received assertions that expect every malformed authenticated DIO option set to unjoin the leaf and erase neighbors. Production parsing rejects these packets before router mutation, which is the fail-closed/DoS-resistant behavior: malformed input must not tear down a valid parent. Update the regression to assert RplRejected with joined/neighbor state unchanged and preserve subsequent valid DIO handling.
